steps.text: Talk to Ranulph in the west part of Auburnvale to start the quest.
Talk to Isadora to learn about carving.
Return to Isadora after carving the spirit animals into the totem.
Carve a Buffalo into the totem base.
Carve a Jaguar into the totem base.
Carve a Eagle into the totem base.
Carve a Snake into the totem base.
Carve a Scorpion into the totem base.
Carve spirit animals you see into the totem.
Decorate the totem with one decorative item (shield, longbow, or shortbow) of the same wood type you used to build/carve the totem.
Decorate the totem with two decorative items (shield, longbow, or shortbow) of the same wood type you used to build/carve the totem.
Decorate the totem with three decorative items (shield, longbow, or shortbow) of the same wood type you used to build/carve the totem.
Decorate the totem with four decorative items (shield, longbow, or shortbow) of the same wood type you used to build/carve the totem.
Return to Isadora to talk after decorating the totem.
Claim the offering the Ent left next to your totem.
Return to Isadora to finish the quest.
